workout.warmup: Incline walk · 8–10 min · 3.3–3.5 mph · 6–8% incline — NOT optional on lower day, this is your back warmup. Extra important after a lot of walking + a long car ride stiffened things up.
workout.finisher: Incline walk · 10 min · 3.3–3.5 mph · 6–8% incline. Skip if session hits 65 min.
workout.coach_note: Monday was rest (legs still carrying Friday + travel). This is Tuesday, legs should feel good. Rotating the squat to leg press (hack squat was Friday). Glute-focused hip thrust instead of another hinge since you did RDLs Friday. PF machines vary by location — gauge load by first-set reps, aim to land ~10. Bring straps when you next do RDL/deadlift; grip was your only limiter Friday.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.note: You hit 390 for a clean 3x10 on 7/6. Start there; if set 1 of 10 is smooth, add a plate. Rotating back to leg press after Friday's hack squat. Controlled, no lockout.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.note: 70 for 10/10/11 on 7/10 and hamstrings felt great. Same weight, chase 12 on all sets — once you own 3x12, go to 75. Cap at 10 if they feel tight.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Smith or DB)
exercises.note: Glute focus, and a break from hinging after Friday's RDLs. Smith bar across the hips with a pad, or a heavy DB. Full hip extension, hard squeeze at top, NO hyperextension. Load for a strong 12.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.note: You've skipped this a few times — get it in. Quad isolation, squeeze at the top, slow negative. Easy on the back, good burn to finish the quads.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge (DB)
exercises.note: 35 confirmed Friday. Hold here, own all 3 sets clean before going up. Long step, drive through the heel.

exercises.name: Core Circuit (fresh combo) — 2 rounds
exercises.detail: Hanging Knee Raise x12 → Pallof Press 40 x10/side → Side Plank 30s/side
exercises.note: Different from your last two core circuits. All back-safe. Pallof on a cable at 40; band if the cable's taken.
